mechanism: Itraconazole inhibits renal potassium excretion through CYP3A4-mediated effects on renal tubular function and aldosterone metabolism, increasing serum potassium levels.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid concurrent use if possible, especially in patients with renal impairment or taking other potassium-elevating agents; consider potassium supplementation only if clinically necessary with close monitoring.
